data.name: Label7.Text
data.value: MediSched is a clinic appointment management system designed to make scheduling and patient record handling simple, organized, and efficient. It allows users to register patients with their contact information, set and manage appointments, update appointment status as pending, completed, or cancelled, and easily track each patient’s schedule. The system also includes search, sorting, filtering and report generation features, helping clinics manage appointments smoothly and improve overall service.
